notes: CDER letter following an inspection of a radiopharmaceutical facility, citing inadequately supported sterility-test-failure investigations (invalidated results attributed to lab contamination without conclusive evidence, including a Bacillus species recovery and premature discarding of sterility samples before the USP <71> 14-day incubation period), failure to investigate adverse environmental-monitoring trends and to complete investigations timely, and inadequate equipment/EM procedures (contact plating performed right after disinfection, missing ISO 5 EM). All drug/CFR-part details are redacted as (b)(4), so products is empty. The recovered organism is identified only as 'Bacillus species' (genus plus the generic word 'species', not a specific species epithet), so organisms is empty. No recall or product withdrawal is raised in this letter.
